title: QUIC RFC 9000 Connection ID Sequence and Active-Set Floor Verification
verification_method: Focused S5P1P1 requirement-home tests over implicit connection-ID sequence numbers, local sequence increment and overflow boundary behavior, active-set limit retirement handling, issued-CID endpoint route lifetime, active-CID routing, active_connection_id_limit transport-parameter advertisement, and replacement CID emission after retirement, plus Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the S5P1P1 connection-ID sequence and active-set floor, including metadata-only xref closure for previously focused requirement homes in the same family.
expected_result: The focused tests show the initial destination connection ID retires as sequence 0, the preferred-address connection ID retires as sequence 1, replacement NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames use the next sequence number, duplicate local sequence numbers are rejected, max-varint sequence replenishment does not wrap, temporary active-set excess is accepted only when Retire Prior To removes enough older IDs, issued CIDs route until retirement, active issued CIDs route short and long headers, active_connection_id_limit is advertised, and peer retirement supplies a replacement CID.
procedure: Run the focused S5P1P1 sequence and active-set requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The existing peer connection-ID lifecycle runtime design remains in place under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0027.
The NEW_CONNECTION_ID runtime lifecycle topoff design remains in place under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0030.
The S5P2 packet association floor remains closed so endpoint route effects can be trusted as ingress proof.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim local-initiated migration pool completeness, first client-selected Destination Connection ID or Retry-provided CID sequencing closure, Retry integrity validation changes, public API widening, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S5P1P1 sequence and active-set filter passed 19/19, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0220, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0221, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0222, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P1P1-0008, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P1P1-0009, RFC9000-S5-1-1-P4-S2-R01, RFC9000-S5-1-1-P4-S4-R01, and RFC9000-S5-1-1-P6-S1-R01 trace_clean and reports 1,294 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 466 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,535/4,535, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
